# ChainScreen

ChainScreen is a compliance research hub for EU crypto asset service providers (CASPs), focused on sanctions screening, MiCA, EBA restrictive-measures guidance, Travel Rule operations, AML/CFT evidence, vendor selection, and GDPR/data-residency issues.

ChainScreen publishes content only. The public API, wallet checker, lead forms, and developer API documentation were retired on 2026-05-12.

## Company

- DailyMind LTD, HE 439959, Limassol, Cyprus
- Founded by Katerina Bletsch, Limassol, Cyprus
- Website: https://chainscreen.io
- About: https://chainscreen.io/about
- Contact: info@chainscreen.io

## Main Research Areas

- MiCA authorization, CASP licensing, transitional regimes, and ESMA register checks
- EBA restrictive-measures guidance and sanctions-screening governance
- EU Travel Rule implementation and counterparty CASP evidence
- Crypto AML/CFT inspection files, banking evidence, and enforcement lessons
- Sanctions-screening tools, Chainalysis alternatives, false positives, and oracle limitations
- Blockchain analytics depth, source-of-funds tracing, and GDPR/data-residency risk
- Stablecoin compliance developments in the United States where they affect crypto compliance teams

## Content Sections

- Regulations: https://chainscreen.io/regulations/
- Operations: https://chainscreen.io/operations/
- Tools: https://chainscreen.io/tools/
- Technical: https://chainscreen.io/technical/

## Important Context

- Articles are educational research, not legal advice.
- Public pages cite official or primary sources where possible.
- CASPs should verify live obligations with their national competent authority and legal counsel before operational decisions.
